# ezghcloud_vpc (Resource)

Manage an EZGH Cloud vpc.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ipv4_cidr` (String) Canonical IPv4 address space; changes replace the resource.
- `name` (String) Resource name.
- `project_id` (String) Project owning this resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional resource description; null clears it.
- `tags` (Map of String) Customer resource tags.

### Read-Only

- `default_firewall_id` (String) VPC default firewall ID.
- `id` (String) Canonical prefixed resource ID.
- `ipv6_cidr` (String) Service-assigned IPv6 address space.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization owning this resource.
- `resource_name` (String) IAM resource name.
- `status` (String) Current service status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_vpc.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROJECT_ID/RESOURCE_ID'
```
